生成对账明细和汇总，集中查看匹配成功、金额差异及未匹配记录。: Generate reconciliation details and a summary of matched items, amount differences and unmatched records.
导出首张工作表的标色文件：完全一致标绿，容差内匹配标黄；差异及未匹配行不新增颜色: Export the first worksheet with exact matches in green and matches within tolerance in yellow. Other rows receive no new color. The original file is unchanged.
系统会按“匹配字段”把往来明细分组，当前默认使用“分配”。: Rows are grouped by the matching field. The default field is “分配” (Assignment).
每个分组内分别汇总两家公司的“金额字段”，当前默认使用“原币金额”。: Amounts are summed by company within each group. The default amount field is “原币金额” (Original currency amount).
两家公司金额相加等于 0 时标绿；差额绝对值在金额容差内时标黄；超过容差为金额差: A zero combined balance is marked green. A difference within the tolerance is marked yellow; a larger difference is reported as a discrepancy.
必须包含：公司代码or伙伴公司、分配、原币金额: Required columns: 公司代码or伙伴公司 (company/partner code), 分配 (assignment), 原币金额 (original-currency amount)
公司代码or伙伴公司必须且只能有两家公司: The company column must contain exactly two company codes
空白分配会统一按“空白”分组处理: Blank assignments are grouped together as blank
上传往来Excel后自动检查: The workbook will be checked automatically after upload
